quotes: %n waves goodbye, and begins making camp.
%n shouts farewell, and begins cleaning %p gear.
%n grumbles about the long walk home, but %s means it fondly.
%n gives you a rough pat on the back. "Don't die out there."
%n counts %p coins one last time before wandering off.
"I will watch for your return!" shouts %n.
"Yeah? And who will watch you?" snickers %n.
%n's tawny hair distracts you for a moment as she takes her leave.
%n shakes her lovely hair, and smiles farewell.
%n's laughter echoes as she fades into golden light.
%n presses a kiss to your forehead. "Walk with grace, $."
%n clasps your hand in a grip of iron. "Until we meet again, $."
%n's eyes flash like distant thunder as he turns to go.
%n's departure leaves the air smelling faintly of ozone.
